University of Kent GREAT Scholarship 2026 is a joint initiative of the UK Government's GREAT Britain campaign, the British Council, and the University of Kent, as part of the Study UK campaign. The selected scholars will receive a one-time scholarship of £10,000 towards their tuition fees.
To be eligible, an applicant must:
be classified as an overseas fee-payer
hold a conditional offer accepted before 26 April 2026
be starting the course in September 2026
demonstrate experience or a strong interest in the subject area, supported by work experience if applicable
be willing to establish an engagement with the UK as a scholar, through personal and academic fulfilment
be willing to attend a networking event of all UK-based GREAT scholars, to discuss experiences and capture perceptions of studying in the UK
Selected candidates will receive a one-time financial support of £10,000 (one-time) towards the tuition fees.
Academic transcripts, including marksheets and certificates
A short paragraph (500 words maximum) about what has inspired the applicant to apply for the course of interest and what makes them the perfect candidate for this award
The documents must be uploaded in PDF format in less than 500 KB.
